title: Cardiac PET scan
description: A cardiac PET scan uses special imaging technology to create detailed pictures of your heart and check how well it's working. During this outpatient procedure, you'll receive a small amount of radioactive tracer through an IV, then lie still in the scanner for about 20-30 minutes. The scanner detects the tracer's signals to show your doctor blood flow and heart function. This test helps identify areas of poor blood flow or damaged heart tissue. There's minimal radiation exposure, and most people return home the same day with no recovery time needed.
